% Requires: \usepackage{booktabs}
% Source: study_0/map_comparison_friedman.csv, generated by
% scripts/compute_study0_map_comparison_stats.py from study_0/results_all.csv.
% results_all.csv includes the Category B empty-prediction correction (see
% scripts/audit_empty_predictions.py, study_0/logs/empty_predictions_audit.csv,
% and the prediction_corrected column) -- 21 of 900 trials had a harness bug
% (FINAL_ANSWER_PROMPT overwriting a valid in-content answer with an empty
% one) recovered and re-scored. This changed the F1/precision/recall numbers
% below materially from the uncorrected pass -- see git history for the
% uncorrected values if needed for comparison.
% Friedman omnibus test (k=3 related samples: none / ast / ast_compact) per
% metric, over 300 matched (model, task_idx, rep) triples -- 12 models x 5
% tasks x 5 reps, complete for every metric (no missing conditions dropped).
% chi-squared has 2 degrees of freedom (k-1) throughout.

\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\caption{Friedman omnibus test for an effect of map condition (none / AST / AST-compact) on each outcome metric, over 300 matched model $\times$ task $\times$ repetition triples.}
\label{tab:map-comparison-friedman}
\begin{tabular}{@{}l r r@{}}
\toprule
Metric & $\chi^2$ (df=2) & $p$ \\
\midrule
F1                    & 1.67   & .434 \\
Precision              & 3.33   & .189 \\
Recall                 & 2.67   & .263 \\
\addlinespace
Input tokens            & 326.89 & $<$.001 \\
Cached tokens\textsuperscript{a} & 180.91 & $<$.001 \\
Output tokens           & 17.76  & $<$.001 \\
\addlinespace
Turns                   & 71.62  & $<$.001 \\
Wall time (s)           & 5.17   & .076 \\
Cost (USD)              & 182.73 & $<$.001 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

\vspace{4pt}
\footnotesize\textsuperscript{a}Cached tokens are a subset of input tokens, not an additive quantity -- tested separately to isolate an effect on the cached \emph{share} specifically from an effect on total input token volume.
\end{table}
